title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: A ball for every player
hook: Count the balls at your next practice.
intro: Most of practice is waiting for a turn.
statement: Touches build skills. Waiting does not.
q1: Do you make sure every player has a ball —
q2: or share balls and teach taking turns?
q3: How many touches does each kid get?
t1: Every team is different. But skills grow
t2: when each kid has a ball at their feet.
cta: Coaches — how many balls do you bring?
ctaLines: One each. Ask families to bring one. Share in pairs.
ctaPrompt: Share your equipment habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Count the balls at your next practice.
Eight kids share three balls. Most of practice is waiting for a turn.
Touches build skills. Waiting does not.
A ball for everyone or shared balls. Both can work.
How many balls do you bring? Share your habit in the comments.
